command:
set -eu
umask 077
cfg_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/modprobe.d/.usb-storage-blacklist.conf.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$cfg_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '# Managed locally: prevent USB mass-storage kernel driver loading.' 'blacklist usb-storage' 'install usb-storage /bin/false' > "$cfg_tmp"
chown root:root "$cfg_tmp"
chmod 0644 "$cfg_tmp"
restorecon "$cfg_tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
mv "$cfg_tmp" /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
modprobe -r usb-storage 2>/dev/null || { rc=$?; if [ -d /sys/module/usb_storage ]; then exit "$rc"; fi; }
printf '%s\n' 'configuration_installed'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %C %n' /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf
sha256sum /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf
